[[File:BaranDoRobes-TSL.jpg|thumb|125px]]
These '''[[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]]''' were worn by the elite members of the [[Baran Do]] order. The Baran Do were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] of the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] race and had been advisors and seers to the leaders of Kel Dor society. Their philosophy centered on seeking inner peace and consulting with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] before making decisions. They also had the ability to see into the future.
